user.title: Connect Skylight lists
user.description:
1. Press F12 in your browser, open the **Network** tab and tick **Preserve log**.
2. In that same tab, open [Skylight sign-in]({auth_url}) and sign in. If you are already signed in to Skylight in this browser, this step may be skipped.
3. Skylight's page redirects a few times. Type `code=` in the Network filter and copy the first `ourskylight.com/welcome?code=…` URL (right-click → Copy → Copy URL).
4. Paste the whole URL (or just the code) below and submit straight away. Codes are single-use and short-lived.

If a code is rejected, open the same link again for a fresh one; it stays valid for this dialog. Make sure the browser is signed in to the right Skylight account.

This unofficial integration requests Skylight's broad `everything` scope even though it only uses lists.
